column10: No WHO AQG. AOD/AI must not be treated as surface PM concentration.
column11: Terra/Aqua MODIS for AOD; Aura OMI for UV Aerosol Index.

column11: Terra/Aqua MODIS LST. ECOSTRESS can provide higher-resolution thermal observations in appropriate areas.

column10: No single global WHO outdoor temperature standard. Use climate/season-specific heat and cold exposure metrics.
column11: AIRS/AMSU-A provides atmospheric temperature profiles. For near-surface temperature, use MERRA-2/GEOS-CF rather than treating an AIRS profile value as surface temperature.

column10: No WHO outdoor atmospheric-health standard. Indoor 40–60% comfort values must not be used as an outdoor global health standard.
column11: AIRS/AMSU-A atmospheric humidity profiles; MERRA-2/GEOS-CF preferred for consistent near-surface RH.

column11: Terra/Aqua MODIS vegetation products; Landsat 8/9 OLI for higher spatial resolution; HLS for harmonized Landsat/Sentinel-2.

column10: No universal WHO/NASA global standard. Define local planning target.

column10: No universal WHO standard. Use hydrological/heat/runoff context.
column11: Landsat-based impervious-surface products, including NASA/SEDAC historical products; current mapping can use Landsat/HLS.
